Proposition
[Curvature bounds for $r\le 0$] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0127 1. Proposition 5.15\group normalized-ricci-flow

Let $(\M ^2,g(t))$ be a solution of the normalized Ricci flow on a compact surface with $r\le 0$. Then there exists a constant $C\ge 1$, depending only on $g(0)$, such that for as long as the solution exists, \[ \frac1C \le R(x,t)\le C \] and the metrics $g(t)$ remain uniformly equivalent to $g(0)$.
